ModMetaData.name: Local Tweaks (sammael)
ModMetaData.author: sammael
ModMetaData.description: Personal XML tweaks. Same list as the README on GitHub. - Vanilla Quests Expanded - Ancients: decorative pneumatic tubes in vaults can be deconstructed (launch port and termini left alone). - Cyanobot's Plant Gen Patches + Biomes! Oasis: drops RG_Plant_JoshuaTree / RG_Plant_WingCactus from biome wild plants while ReGrowth 2 keeps those defs commented out. - Consistent Text: restores the Alpha Animals refinery recipe label (AA_ExtractUranium) its patch deletes. - Alpha Genes + Cherry Picker: removes the cherry-picked AG_DecreasedCommandRange gene from the random-mutation blacklist. - Flourish - Everyday Animations + Show Me Your Tools: children's floor drawing without Flourish's extra hands and body-lowering track. - Flourish - Everyday Animations: telescope pose mirrored so the pawn stands on the eyepiece side, facing East. - Show Me Your Tools: no floating handheld spyglass while using a telescope (kept for skygazing). - Hauler's Dream: batch crafting gets the same Flourish animations and Show Me Your Tools tools as a normal bill.
